title: ecbolium verticillare
intro: Ecbolium verticillare, commonly known as the upright ecbolium, is a flowering plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of ecbolium verticillare include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
